prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 37 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1092; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Treatment summary, cervical region. The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headaches. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the cervical injury diagnosed. Examination revealed reduced range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support the diagnosis. Neurological screening, reflexes, and imaging were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical spine is known. Care has included 37 visits to date. Over time, the frequency and scope of services expanded beyond what is typically expected for this injury, with additional modalities added in later months. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate charges for the same services. Ongoing care and the expected duration of treatment will be reassessed at the next scheduled review.
